text: Have code files been scanned for translation?
Are new forms designed according to IFS AQS guidelines?
Do cursors and SQL statements select against tables where suitable?
Are variables defined as %TYPE in PL/SQL?
Has the correct base layer (Ext or Core) been selected when extending?
Are customized files checked into Harvest with version 0 without changes?
Are COB/INS/UPG files written so they can be run several times?
Is the code indentation correct, and do blank lines separate code blocks?
Is the customization implemented in a minimally invasive way?
Are overrides used instead of overtakes?
Are there no warnings or errors shown in Developer Studio?
